description: This Dart source file provides test helper functions for Flutter widget testing, particularly for initializing the sqflite FFI database, pumping frames with a bounded wait, and cleaning up resources such as download engines and databases after tests.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite package to use the FFI implementation for testing, preventing hangs in non-platform environments like CI.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps widget frames until the widget tree settles or a maximum duration is reached, avoiding indefinite hanging during tests.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up app dependencies such as closing the database and canceling ongoing download tasks to ensure proper test teardown.
